The contract is conditional on a full advance payment for the first year.

Professional Ser vices
• Network Design & Installation Support
Anchor layout planning - Develop the preliminary and final anchor layout plans that includes anchor locations
considering application requirements and environment restrictions. Eliko will give guidelines how to attach anchors. The
result is a final and agreed anchor placement plan that will the basis for installing the anchors.
Communication network design & anchor installation - Each anchor requires power and communication. Eliko
will will give guidelines how to power the anchors and supply communication. The communication network design &
installation is done by a local partner. The anchors come with mounts with screw holes for permanent wall or ceiling
attachment.
• Network Configuration
Anchor location measurement and configuration - After the anchors are in place, all anchor locations need to
be translated into XYZ coordinates relative to the room plan. Anchor location coordinates will be inserted into the
RTLS Manager that can be either performed by Eliko engineers or the local installation team. Proximity or distance-
based applications require configuration of proximity radiuses.
System configuration and verification - The system configuration entails all activities related to setting up the
RTLS Core software. Configuration includes selecting the right filters and settings for the use case, configuring the
zones,events,event-based alarms to tags or to the application-level software,and any other parameter on the software
side to achieve the desired result.Before handing over the project.Eliko engineers will verify the setup and location data
accuracy, by gathering real-time data from the system and analysing it to make sure the network performance is as
agreed.It also includes training for system engineers and managers on the system functionalities.

Professional Ser vices
• Technical support
Troubleshoot and advise clients on technical matters beyond planning and setting up standard positioning
networks.
• Hardware and software customization
Developments and modifications based on Eliko's standard hardware and software according to the customer’s
request and specifications.

General Terms
• Eliko reserves the right to change prices without notice.
• Software licenses are subject to the terms set forth in the Eliko EULA.
• All hardware is subject to Eliko's general warranty conditions.
• Delivery conditions are agreed separately with the customer and may differ depending
on the destination country and the customer.
